placement.note: DRAW AT 1:1. world_px_height IS the art's own alpha bbox height, so the scale is 1 — never resample scenery. world_height_m is what the art reads as beside a 87px character; declared_height_m is what it was once declared to be, and a gap between them means the ART is the wrong size.
